title: Prompt Tuning Pushes Farther, Contrastive Learning Pulls Closer: A Two-Stage Approach to Mitigate Social Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring internal stereotype associations using Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT), fill-in-the-blank stereotype tests (StereoSet), and masked token probabilities for stereotypes (CrowS-Pairs). External fairness is evaluated on downstream tasks measuring true positive rate gaps in occupation prediction (Bias-in-Bios) and neutrality in natural language inference (Bias-NLI).
